provider.note: Identical to 39557190033 and 39793858384: same model, same effort, same gateway.

composition.stated: Public egress, no filtered-egress probe, no contamination gate, one attempt per cell, each cell's own declared budget, fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1, the same grader. The only declared deltas are the candidate and two additional image mirrors.
composition.whyTheseDeltasStayComparable: An image mirror changes where the same digest-pinned image is fetched from, never its bytes, so it cannot change what a cell measures. It removes the one infra failure this corpus has repeatedly hit.
composition.parallelism: fh_max_parallel=8 is a scheduling choice only: it changes how many cells run at once, never a cell's budget, timeout or grader.

Both seeds self-proved: with the source registry blackholed in /etc/hosts, a compose build from the pinned reference still resolved through the mirror (`build-succeeded-with-source-registry-blackholed`). The remaining two datacurve images (anko-typed-variable-bindings, httpx-multipart-response-parsing) are still pulled from their frozen references; a rate limit there would be recorded as infra, never as a model failure.
mitigation.noCleanClaim: No contamination gate and public egress, so this run claims no cell was clean. Any cell whose record is to be used as a capability reading still needs its own contamination receipt.

constraints: One predeclared attempt per cell over the exact frozen corpus; no second attempt in this manifest.
No verdict, frozen record or artifact of 39557190033, 39620264048, 39700728172, 39721121070 or 39793858384 is replaced, repaired or reinterpreted by this run.
Nothing here is read as a model-capability result: with public egress and no contamination gate, a model failure cannot be separated from an answer source a cell may have reached.
Every error cell keeps its mechanical cause (environment build, rate limit, transport, budget) in the record; an error is never counted as a model failure.
A model.patch of 0 bytes means the collect hook graded the pristine tree; such a cell's f2p is not the model's work and the record says so.
No budget, timeout or effort is extended to make any cell scoreable.

knownRisks.ecrRateLimit: The two 429 cells of 39793858384 are mirrored here, but anko and httpx are not, so an environment-build 429 is still possible and would be recorded as infra.
knownRisks.transport: 39793858384 lost 472 s to transport stalls plus one 1,800 s single-call timeout in arktype; 39557190033 lost 2,246 s. Nothing in this candidate claims to fix that.
knownRisks.noContaminationGate: Public egress and no gate: a cell that reaches its upstream solution is not detected here.
knownRisks.emptyPatchCaptureGap: The datacurve collect hook diffs base..HEAD, so a cell that edits without committing still grades the pristine tree. 39793858384 hit this in arktype; it is a harness contract gap, not changed here.
knownRisks.rerun: One attempt per cell. A cell that fails keeps its canonical verdict; no retry is admitted by this manifest.

plannedChecks: Read the aggregate report first (per-cell disposition, rewards, durationMs, usage, acceptance criteria). Compare cell by cell against 39793858384 and, where it has a verdict, against 39557190033; state the arithmetic only. For each failed or error cell, read its own frozen record and evidence to name the mechanical cause, and read its tool closures to say whether a tool admission refusal was involved and whether each refusal was correct. Freeze report.json as its own record beside the earlier ones with a hand-written note that says this run has no filtered-egress probe and no contamination gate, so nothing here is a clean capability reading.
